name: command-global
description: MENTOR — you didn't just write the bug, you designed it. Built on the COMMAND platform (NitroStack MCP app) + the Lumina design canvas.

scripts.pack: npm --prefix sentinel exec -- nitrostack-cli pack --cwd sentinel -o mentor-deploy.zip
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix mcp-roster run build && npm --prefix sentinel run build && npm --prefix mcp-profile run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix mcp-roster test && npm --prefix sentinel test && npm --prefix mcp-profile test
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix mcp-roster install && npm --prefix sentinel install && npm --prefix mcp-profile install && npm run lumina:install
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run sync:shared -- --check && npm run fixture:check && npm run walk && npm run check:docs
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify && npm run fixture:plan

author: Team COMMAND
